decision: Adopt (or reject) the wall-order-parameter wetting formulation of the OSS reference ebinan92/Fingering_dynamics as the diffuse-interface wetting mechanism of TensorLBM, and fix its quantitative contact-angle law theta(psi_w) for reuse.
alternatives: A1: keep the existing colour-gradient geometrical wetting BC (AKAI2018, src/tensorlbm/cg_wetting2d.py) as the only diffuse wetting mechanism
A2: port the OSS scheme verbatim (ghost wall order parameter + its order-parameter closure) and use it as is

A3: port the wall-order-parameter wall condition but equilibrate with a mass-conserving Allen-Cahn descent that shares the same free energy, stencils and ghost rows (A3 = adopted, because A2 fails the steadiness test)
hypothesis: H1: the wall order parameter psi_w sets the static contact angle through cos(theta) = (3 psi_w - psi_w^3)/2 (Young's law with the wall free energy implied by the Dirichlet ghost). H2: an implementation of the same wall condition with an independent numerical method reproduces that law within 15%.

metrics.primary: static contact angle theta [deg] of a sessile cap, measured by inverting the Laplace-cap relation from the conserved excess area A = sum((psi+1)/2) and the apex height h above the wall plane (wall plane = y = -1/2, halfway bounce-back)
metrics.secondary: circle fit of the psi = 0 level set at least 1.5 interface widths above the wall (cross-check, must agree within 5 deg on the non-wetting branch)

baseline_control: analytic Young law cos(theta) = (3 psi_w - psi_w^3)/2 evaluated at the same psi_w (reference), plus the psi_w = 0 case where the law gives exactly 90 deg by symmetry (exact control)
stopping_rule: a port run stops when max|psi(t) - psi(t-200)| < 1e-8 (port_tolerance) or at max_iter = 30000 iterations; a run that hits max_iter without the tolerance is reported as converged = false and its theta is kept but flagged

controlled: upper wall value psi_wall_top = -1 (far field of the wetting phase)
confounders: spurious psi diffusion of the reference order-parameter closure (measured separately in the lbm arm)
finite resolution xi/dx = 2 is only 2 lattice units wide -> discretisation of the double well
top-wall truncation: the upper wall is 40 lattice units above the wall plane, so its influence on the cap is O((xi/h)^2)
cap relation assumes the drop is a circular arc; gravity is absent in the model so this is exact up to lattice anisotropy

repetition_rationale: The problem is deterministic (no random seeds, no turbulence); repeats are used only for the two systematic sweeps (psi_w and xi), each row being one independent equilibration. Determinism was verified by re-running one case twice (identical theta to 1e-10).
analysis: Per row: err = (theta_port - theta_ref)/theta_ref * 100 with theta_ref = analytic law value; pass iff |err| <= 15. Aggregate: median and max |err| over the psi_w sweep at the baseline xi = 3; convergence: |theta(xi=3) - theta(xi=4)|/theta(xi=4) <= 10 to declare the angle resolution independent; sensitivity points: xi and psi_w (both swept).
safety_resource_limits: each port run < 90 s on one core, lbm arm < 120 s, oss arm submitted to the cluster queue when it exceeds 10 min; no node pinning
interpretation_limits: the law is a static-equilibrium statement; dynamic (Cox-Voinov) wetting is out of scope
the 15% gate is applied to the angle in degrees; near psi_w = +-1 the angle tends to 0/180 deg where a relative error is ill conditioned, so the sweep is limited to |psi_w| <= 0.7
the OSS code as published cannot be run to equilibrium at this resolution (documented in the report); it therefore informs the structural diff list, not the numeric gate
discovered_during_work: the OSS file as committed raises AttributeError (stencils defined at module level, called as methods) -> documented patch P1
the OSS published main() puts the drop at the box centre (no contact line) -> documented patch P2

the reference order-parameter closure carries spurious psi-diffusion proportional to cs^2 (tau_g - 1/2) lap(psi), which homogenises a cap for mobility Gamma <~ 1 -> this drove alternative A3 and is quantified in the lbm arm
